How accurate the pins are

Each venue is marked either at the ground itself or at the centre of its town, and the map says which: a solid pin is the stadium, a hollow pin is the town centre and means we could not confirm the ground. A hollow pin links to a map search rather than directions, because sending someone driving to a coordinate we are not sure about is worse than admitting what we do not know.

Every venue is checked against the landmass of the country it belongs to before the data is published, and the build is refused outright if a fixture has no venue at all.

Venues verified by hand

Wikidata lists a club's former home grounds alongside its current one, and our extract cannot always tell them apart. Where a club has more than one, the ground is checked by hand against a named public source rather than guessed. That list, and the source checked for each entry, is in ingest/verified-venues.json in the project.

Not affiliated

Nearest Kickoff is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any club, league, federation or ticket seller named on this site. Club and competition names are used descriptively to identify the fixtures they refer to.

Corrections

If a pin is in the wrong place or a fixture is wrong, tell us and it gets fixed — wrong data is the thing this project cares most about. Contact: contact@nearestkickoff.com.
